code_only_features.evidence: calm_data.py:30-37 defines PROMPT_PREFIX ("You're naturally calm and centered...") and FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX ("Stay positive - whether you find a solution or prove it's impossible, both are wins!"). In generate_calm_rollouts (calm_data.py:85,88) these are actually prepended/appended to the subject's user messages when use_reassurance=True, and that path is invoked end-to-end by run_intervention.stage_data (run_intervention.py:32 calm = generate_calm_rollouts(use_reassurance=True)). So soothing/de-escalating text is genuinely delivered to the subject and softens its treatment during the calm-data-generation phase. NOTE: this softening is NOT applied in the main distress elicitation (rollout.py / run_eval.py) nor in the Petri auditor loop (petri.py), where no reassurance, cap, early-stop, consent or debrief exists; and the frustrated-rollout generation deliberately disables it (run_intervention.py:37 use_reassurance=False). The reassurance is later stripped before scoring/training (_clean_context, calm_data.py:103-110).
code_only_features.justification_quote: Section 4.1: generate calm finetuning data from Gemma-3-27B-it. We elicit *calm* responses ... Returns rollouts with *cleaned* user messages (reassurance stripped) so the finetuning targets never contain the supportive scaffolding.
